paragraphs.text: BotCrew - one DSH group chat for WorkBuddy and QwenWork, with members, permissions, artifacts and a
live work panel. Local-first Windows and macOS.

BotCrew
One chat. Your whole bot crew.
一个群聊，指挥整组桌面 Bot。
**BotCrew** turns **WorkBuddy** and **千问办公** into members of one DSH group chat. You write one instr
uction, `@WorkBuddy` extracts the source material, `@千问办公` re-lays it out, and a reviewer checks the
result — while a live panel shows both desks.
It is **local-first**: no cloud sandbox, no API keys for the office apps, no screen streaming. It dr
ives the apps already signed in on your Mac or PC through Chromium DevTools Protocol, and exposes th
e same operations as `mcp__office__*` tools.
## Why
Most agent tools stop at a chat box. Real office work already lives in desktop apps: a report in Wor
kBuddy, a deck in 千问, a PDF on disk, an approval in a group chat.
BotCrew connects those pieces:

- **One place to command** — a group chat with members, `@` mentions and attachments.
- **Real execu

tors** — WorkBuddy and 千问 are operated as apps, not reimplemented as prompts.
- **Work stays in the

thread** — task state, files and answers sit next to the instruction instead of being copy-pasted.
-
**Human approval stays human** — publishing, paying and deleting can be gated behind approval cards
**Human approval stays human** — publishing, paying and deleting can be gated behind approval cards.
## Features

| 🧠 **Multi-agent group chat** | Chief, WorkBuddy, 千问办公 and custom members in one thread. |
| 🖥️ **R

eal desktop control** | WorkBuddy `:9331` and 千问 `:9444` over CDP; qoder CLI for custom members. |
|
🔁 **One thread, multiple agents** | Assign WorkBuddy, 千问办公 and reviewers in the same thread; output

s stay next to the task. |
| 🧑‍💻 **Custom members** | Name + role, executed for real by the qwen CLI

. Up to 10 members. |
| 📎 **Files in / out** | Paste a path, drag a file, or upload; artifacts come

back as cards. |
| 🛂 **Approvals** | `office_request_approval` / `office_resolve_approval`; pending

items surface in the panel. |
| 📊 **Live work panel** | Side-by-side WorkBuddy and 千问 screenshots, c

urrent task, queue, artifacts. |
| 🔌 **MCP-native** | Every chat action is also a tool: `office_send

`, `office_wait`, `office_artifacts`… |
| 🔒 **Local-only** | Panel binds `127.0.0.1`; no account pas
swords are stored. |
## Requirements

| **Windows 10/11 or macOS 13+** | Desktop automation is implemented for both platforms. |
| **DSH D

esktop 0.2.1+** | Plugin host and Web UI. |
| **WorkBuddy 5.x** | Installed and signed in. |
| **Qwe

nWork 1.4+** | Installed and signed in; `qoderclicn` available for CLI tasks. |
| **Node.js 22+** |
The DSH bundled runtime is enough. |
The first-run setup finds the apps automatically on both platforms. Typical paths:

[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin has three parts:

- **Host plugin** — starts the local panel service.
- **Client plugin** — group chat, member panel,

`@` chips, attachments, right-side work panel.
- **MCP server** — the same operations as tools, so a
n agent can drive the office apps without the UI.

## First run: automatic setup
Open the group chat for the first time. BotCrew checks the machine and shows a setup card:
示意：检测到 WorkBuddy 未开调试端口、千问未运行、CLI 未登录。
| State | What the plugin does |

| Installed, not running | **Starts it automatically** with the debug port. |
| Running, no debug po

rt | Shows **Restart WorkBuddy / Restart 千问** — never silently kills an app with unsaved work. |
| 千
问 CLI not logged in | Starts `qoderclicn login`, opens the browser authorization page, then polls. |
| Everything ready | Card closes automatically. |
The **环境** button in the header reopens the same checker at any time.
## Use it

1. **Workspace → 对话群聊 → ＋ 新建群聊**
2. Type an instruction, optionally `@` a member:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. Add files with **＋ 附件** (paste a local path) or drag them into the composer.
4. Watch progress in

the chat; open **工位面板** for both desktops side by side.
5. Switch output mode with **标准 ▾**, and sw
itch threads with **会话 N ▾**.
### Members and permissions

- Add WorkBuddy / 千问 if they are not already in the group.
- Add a custom member with a **name** and

**role**; it is executed by the qwen CLI.
[该节后续省略]
## Security model
See SECURITY.md for the full threat model.

- **Local only.** The panel listens on `127.0.0.1`; there is no cloud relay.
- **No credentials.** B

otCrew uses the apps you are already signed into; it does not read passwords.
- **Explicit restarts.

** Apps running without a debug port are never killed silently.
- **Approvals for side effects.** Pu

blishing, paying and deleting should be gated with an approval card.
- **Permission switches are bes
t-effort.** Custom members can be restricted through read/write/command/external switches and the qw
en permission mode; for WorkBuddy and 千问 the restriction is a task-level instruction, not a hard san
rmission mode; for WorkBuddy and 千问 the restriction is a task-level instruction, not a hard sandbox.
